topics.name: UserModule Instance Data Surface
topics.purpose: Define the full UserModule instance as the isolation and addressing boundary for module-local data, input state and schema-bound values.

semantics.boundary_rule: Local module data is scoped to the full runtime UserModule instance identity.
semantics.definition_rule: Module definition identity and instance data identity are distinct.
semantics.schema_rule: Instance data surface follows the module's explicit schema binding.
semantics.relation_rule: Cross-instance access requires explicit canonical relation or remote/external binding.
semantics.input_rule: Input-type modules write only into their declared instance/input surfaces.
semantics.view_rule: View-type modules project data and do not acquire local data ownership merely by reading it.
semantics.adapter_rule: Adapter-type modules map between surfaces without merging their identities.
semantics.isolation_rule: Same schema/type/name across instances never merges their local data.

invariants.rule: UserModule type behavior is explicit and narrow: input acquires/writes inert data, adapter translates/mounts, view projects, and no type silently acquires another type's authority.

hard_gates.condition: instance data addressed only by module definition identity where multiple instances exist

references.purpose: Instance data is scoped to explicit UserModule instance.
DWH uses the same full-instance isolation boundary.
